Transforming Ideas Into Solutions That Improve Everyday Life
Our proprietary drug delivery solutions, consumer dispensing, dosing and protection technologies add value to some of the world’s most trusted and innovative brands, making an impact on the everyday lives of millions of patients and consumers around the globe.
Supporting Your BusinessA Collaborative and Comprehensive Approach
We help our customers go to market with support and services throughout the development process. From early concepts to commercialization, we partner with you every step of the way.
Awards & Recognition
We are recognized around the world for our innovative products, responsible behavior, commitment to the environment and good corporate governance. These awards are just a snapshot of Aptar’s impact.
How can we help?
We’re here to help with product development. Whether you’re working on a new product, looking to become a partner or everything in between.

Partner with Us
We're here to help with product development. Whether you're working on a new device, looking to become a supplier-or everything in between-your partnership is valued.
Contact an Expert

## We are Novolex

Novolex is a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging servicing customers
across a wide range of industries, including foodservice, restaurant delivery and carryout, food
processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors.

With an extensive and innovative product portfolio, we help businesses operate efficiently, meet
evolving customer expectations, and deliver everyday essentials to millions of consumers around the
world.

## Join our team

At Novolex, our people are at the heart of Packaging for a Better Future through choice, innovation,
and sustainability. We offer opportunities to grow, learn, and contribute in meaningful ways across
our manufacturing facilities, offices, and distribution centers. Explore our open roles and see how
you can be part of our growing organization.

[ View Jobs ][26]

## Community

As a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging, Novolex is uniquely positioned
to help address food insecurity and support the communities where we live and work. Our company-wide
Month of Action is one way we empower our teams to give back. Through local volunteer efforts and
charitable contributions, employees support the organizations and causes that matter most to them
and their families.

[ Learn More ][27]

## Choice, Innovation, & Sustainability

[Product Choices for Your Business Needs]

### Product Choices for Your Business Needs

Novolex offers one of the industry’s broadest portfolios of packaging solutions designed to
safeguard, preserve, and showcase food and beverages for customers across diverse markets.

[ View Products ][28]
[ Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers]

### Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers

As market needs evolve, Novolex provides material and product choices that support performance,
sustainability, and speed-to-market. Our teams of material scientists and engineers enable us to
help customers transition to more sustainable alternatives efficiently and effectively.

[Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet]

### Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet

We fulfill the Novolex promise of choice, innovation and sustainability beginning with the materials
we select. Over time, we have expanded the diversity of substrates used across our product lines to
meet both functional requirements and customer sustainability goals.

## Sustainability

We believe in sustainability, so much that it is part of our company mission and vision. Our
sustainability initiatives can be found throughout our facilities from electricity savings to water
recycling. Our most impactful program is our EcoStar® post-consumer recycled material, that is made
of 75% or more recycled content.

[
Learn More
][29]

## Innovation

Our award winning team brings design elements to each project that utilize unique tool designs,
intricate trim features and achieve elegant functionality from simple open and closing, to
tamper-evident mechanisms. The experience our design team can bring to each project truly sets us
apart as we look to create, design and innovate packaging to protect and enhance your product on
shelf.

[
Learn More
][30]

## Collaboration

We listen to understand your product and work together to create an award winning design that
highlights your product. Our team will work with you every step of the way to exceed your
expectations from ideation to production. We make sure you, the customer is satisfied.

Learn More

Costruite interamente in acciaio inox, le termoformatrici AL.MA. destinate al settore alimentare
servono **pastifici, salumifici, caseifici **e l’industria alimentare nelle sue varie forme, come ad
esempio l’**industria dolciaria**, della **lavorazione della carne** e dei **prodotti da forno**.
L’esperienza acquisita e la conoscenza approfondita del settore ci consentono di realizzare macchine
su misura che rispettano le dinamiche non solo settoriali, ma anche della singola realtà aziendale
con cui collaboriamo.

# [Our industries][50]

Our teams have a deep understanding of plastics processing across all markets. Find out how we can
support your business on a global scale.
* [[Recycling hero image]Recycling & sustainability][51]
  
  # [Recycling & sustainability][52]
  
  The development of recycling technologies is reshaping our industry and supporting the role of
  plastics in the circular economy. Be market-ready with the latest supply chain reports and events.
  
  [Discover More][53]
* [[Masterbatch hero image]Compounds, additives & masterbatch][54]
  
  # [Compounds, additives & masterbatch][55]
  
  Compounds and masterbatch are an essential link between plastic converters and polymer producers.
  Drawing on 40 years of experience, our strategic intelligence and events can help you leverage
  expert research and connect with key players.
  
  [Discover More][56]
* [[Energy hero image]Energy & infrastructure][57]
  
  # [Energy & infrastructure][58]
  
  Polymeric materials are growing in the energy and infrastructure sector. Our expertise includes
  pipes, wind turbine blades, roofing membranes, artificial grass and more. Take a look at our
  reports and events for detailed insights into these applications.
  
  [Discover More][59]
* [[Flexible films hero image]Flexible films][60]
  
  # [Flexible films][61]
  
  The flexible films industry is the largest consumer of plastics. It’s also facing the biggest
  changes in the drive to meet sustainability targets. Our latest market research and events will
  provide the knowledge and contacts you need to survive and thrive in this sector.
  
  [Discover More][62]
* [[Rigid packaging hero image]Rigid packaging][63]
  
  # [Rigid packaging][64]
  
  Rigid plastics packaging continues to grow with the emergence of new markets and opportunities,
  including single-serve capsules. This growth is coinciding with the drive towards more sustainable
  solutions. Harness our expertise in emerging applications, processing options, materials demand
  and recycling technologies to map out your strategic plans.
  
  [Discover More][65]
* [[Extrusion hero image]Extrusion][66]
  
  # [Extrusion][67]
  
  Recent technical and functional innovations in polymer extrusion have enabled cost-effective,
  high-volume production across a spectrum of applications. With our knowledge and market reports in
  this field, we can offer you expert analysis and actionable intelligence.
  
  [Discover More][68]
* [[Raw materials and distribution]Raw materials & distribution][69]
  
  # [Raw materials & distribution][70]
  
  The supply and distribution of plastics is complex and dynamic. Inter-material competition,
  evolving distribution models, increasing globalisation and the growing use of recyclates are all
  playing their part. Discover how demand and routes to market are changing for different polymers,
  so you can identify growth niches, manage threats and navigate the future landscape.
  
  [Discover More][71]
* [[Hero area image]Textile recycling][72]
  
  # [Textile recycling][73]
  
  Textile waste is an urgent issue, driven by regulatory developments and increasing consumer
  pressures. Emerging textile recycling technologies are transforming the industry and accelerating
  the shift to a circular economy. Stay ahead of this fast-changing market with our global events,
  in-depth market intelligence, and leading industry publications.
  
  [Discover More][74]

# Custom Injection Mold Manufacturer China | Precision Plastic Injection Molding Supplier

CKMOLD is a China-based custom injection mold manufacturer specializing in precision plastic
injection molds, injection molding, overmolding, insert molding and production parts for automotive,
medical and industrial applications.

[ Submit Your Inquiry ][18]

## Custom Injection Mold Manufacturer in China

##### Precision Plastic Injection Molds & Injection Molding Services From Prototype to Mass
##### Production 20+ Years Experience | ISO 9001 Certified | 300+ Molds/year | Export Worldwide

### Injection Molding Tools
* Custom mold design
* Prototype molding
* High-volume production molds
* Maintenance and repair of molds
* Overmolding and insert molding

### CNC Machining Services
* Precision CNC milling
* CNC turning (lathes)
* 3D CNC machining
* Complex surface machining
* Prototype and production runs

### Quality Assurance & Inspection
* Comprehensive quality checks
* Advanced measurement tools and techniques
* Process validation
* Real-time monitoring and feedback

### Consultation Services
* Product design consultation
* Material selection guidance
* Process optimization

## Frequently Asked Questions

What materials can you work with for injection molding and CNC machining?

At CKmold, we work with a wide range of materials to meet diverse industry requirements. For
injection molding, this includes plastics like ABS, Polyethylene, Polycarbonate, and specialized
engineering plastics. For CNC machining, we handle metals such as aluminum, stainless steel, H13,
P20, 1.2311, 1.2344,and brass, as well as various plastics and composite materials. If you have a
specific material in mind, please contact us, and we’ll discuss the best approach for your project.

How do you ensure the quality of the finished products?

Quality assurance is a cornerstone of our operations. We employ a rigorous inspection process at
every stage of production, from raw material sourcing to the final product. Utilizing
state-of-the-art measurement tools and techniques, our dedicated QA team ensures that every piece
meets the highest standards of precision and durability. Moreover, our processes are continuously
refined based on feedback and the latest industry best practices.

Can you assist with design and material selection for my project?

Absolutely! We offer comprehensive consultation services where our team of experts can guide you
through product design considerations and recommend the most suitable materials based on your
project’s requirements, budget, and desired outcomes. Our aim is to ensure your product is both
functional and cost-effective.

What's the typical lead time for a project?

The lead time for a project can vary depending on several factors, including the complexity of the
design, the chosen material, and the volume of the order. Generally, prototype projects can be
turned around quickly, while high-volume production runs require more time. We recommend discussing
your specific needs with our team for a more accurate estimate.

How do you handle large-volume orders and supply chain management?

CKmold is well-equipped to manage high-volume orders with our advanced machinery and optimized
production processes. Additionally, we offer comprehensive supply chain management services,
ensuring timely material procurement, efficient production scheduling, and streamlined logistics
solutions. Our goal is to ensure your project stays on track, regardless of its scale.

Are there any industries or sectors you specialize in serving?

While CKmold has the expertise and equipment to cater to a broad range of industries, we’ve
accumulated significant experience serving sectors like automotive, consumer electronics, medical
devices, and aerospace. Our diverse portfolio ensures that we bring a wealth of knowledge to every
project, making us a preferred partner for many industry leaders.

## EVCO Is a Certified Women’s Business Enterprise (WBE)

Certification by the Women’s Business Enterprise National Council (WBENC) affirms that EVCO is at
least 51% owned, controlled, operated and managed by women and has appropriate structure and
strategic business planning and implementation in place. It also reflects the company’s ongoing
commitment to leadership, innovation and inclusion in manufacturing.

substitute for experience.

Over the past year, we’ve continued to improve our sustainability efforts and outputs, advancing
past the EcoVadis Fast Mover designation and earning the Bronze Rating. This award puts us in the
top 35% of all companies assessed, recognizing our significant progress and strong systems in place
for sustainability.

# See what your competitors

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data

## Trusted by teams at

The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

into a single forecast you can act on.

## Email Finder FAQ

If you can't find the answer to your question here, visit the dedicated section in our Help Center.

[Visit Help Center][32]

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

### Where does GetProspect find emails?

GetProspect Email finder uses its powerful database of over 200 million business contacts with
emails and 26 million companies to find email addresses, as well as LinkedIn's largest and most
current business contacts database with over 900 million users.

### How accurate is the Email Finder?

The accuracy of valid emails that were found on the platform is 95%.

According to the latest tests, GetProspect Email Finder found 84 valid email addresses out of 100
contacts, which is higher than in such alternatives as ZoomInfo, Hunter.io, Lusha, ContactOut, and
others.

### How can I extract an email address from a website?

The GetProspect company Email Finder extracts business email addresses from any company website.
Once the extension is installed, it can be used for fetching basic info about the companies,
employees' email addresses and getting essential data about them. Just click on the extension icon
to find emails and leads you need by name or job title.

### Is the Getprospect Email Finder a free service?

GetProspect Email Finder provides lifetime access to 50 free new email addresses each month.

### How much does the Email Finder cost?

Paid Email Finder subscriptions start at $49 per month with 1,000 valid emails and 2,000
verifications. You can find email addresses for just $34 per month with an annual payment. Find out
more about it at [Pricing.][33]

employees' email addresses and getting essential data about them. Just click on the extension icon
to find emails and leads you need by name or job title.

GetProspect Email Finder provides lifetime access to 50 free new email addresses each month.

### How much does the Email Finder cost?

Paid Email Finder subscriptions start at $49 per month with 1,000 valid emails and 2,000
verifications. You can find email addresses for just $34 per month with an annual payment. Find out
more about it at [Pricing.][33]

#### Our services

## Innovative technologies for a wide range of applications

From design optimisation to final packaging we can design a fully automated production and assembly
line dedicated to your products. This will be run by robots 24/7, with in-line quality control
checks, automated continuous parameter testing and will result in minimal scrap rates (less than
1%).

We have been serving a wide range of industries for many applications.

### Material Solution Provider

We are material and technology specialists as we help customers to find unique, ideal materials for
their production. Our products deliver distinctive value, as well as being both efficient and
effective. We help our customers increase their profitability through the innovative materials and
use of our products. 

We contribute to sustainability by making lighter, stronger, and more environmentally friendly
products.

### Plastic Polymers

Over 60 years of experience for all types of plastic and high-performance polymers, from commodity
to expanded and recycled, thermoplastic, techno-polymers and composites.

### Hybrid materials

Our expertise extends to hybrid materials including expanded polypropylene (EPP) and other foam
materials. These materials offer a unique combination of properties to deliver energy absorption,
high structural strength, very low weight, chemical resistance, thermal and acoustic insulation
while being 100% recyclable.

### Integrated Foam

We serve global clients with cutting-edge foam technology for lightweight, cushioning and
insulation.

### Bio & Sustainable Materials

Particularly useful for disposable and short life cycle products.

From design optimisation to final packaging we can design a fully automated production and assembly
line dedicated to your products. This will be run by robots 24/7, with in-line quality control
checks, automated continuous parameter testing and will result in minimal scrap rates (less than

### Material Solution Provider

We are material and technology specialists as we help customers to find unique, ideal materials for
their production. Our products deliver distinctive value, as well as being both efficient and
effective. We help our customers increase their profitability through the innovative materials and
use of our products. 

We contribute to sustainability by making lighter, stronger, and more environmentally friendly
products.

### Plastic Polymers

Over 60 years of experience for all types of plastic and high-performance polymers, from commodity
to expanded and recycled, thermoplastic, techno-polymers and composites.

### Hybrid materials

Our expertise extends to hybrid materials including expanded polypropylene (EPP) and other foam
materials. These materials offer a unique combination of properties to deliver energy absorption,
high structural strength, very low weight, chemical resistance, thermal and acoustic insulation
while being 100% recyclable.

### Integrated Foam

We serve global clients with cutting-edge foam technology for lightweight, cushioning and
insulation.

### Bio & Sustainable Materials

Particularly useful for disposable and short life cycle products.

## Frequently Asked **Questions**

What is JITSY, and how does it work for industrial buyers?
JITSY is the virtual B2B platform that supports industrial buyers to source raw materials smartly
and efficiently. Buyers can compare products, place their orders, compare prices, and manage
deliveries through the simple mobile app designed for industrial purchasing requirements.
How can I buy raw materials from the JITSY mobile app?

To buy raw materials from the JITSY app, download the app first, search for the raw materials,
choose products, add items to the cart, request quotation & proforma invoice, and place an order by
approving securely through the app in a few easy steps.

What types of industrial raw materials does JITSY supply?

JITSY supplies a wide array of industrial raw materials, including polymers, chemicals, additives,
packaging materials, and manufacturing essentials sourced from trusted brands and manufacturers
throughout various industrial categories.

Which industries does JITSY serve with its raw material portfolio?

JITSY serves the raw materials to industries like automotive, construction, plastic, packaging,
chemical, electrical, manufacturing, and consumer goods. We offer reliable accessibility to
high-quality industrial raw materials and supply solutions.

How does JITSY's pricing work? Are there any hidden charges?

JITSY promotes transparent pricing depending on market rates and supply quotations. Buyers will get
transparent details before confirming orders, with zero additional charges involved in the
purchasing process.

How does JITSY ensure the quality and authenticity of raw materials?

JITSY sources products from verified manufacturers and trusted suppliers while managing strict
quality inspections to verify that buyers obtain quality industrial raw materials for their
workflows.

How does JITSY handle delivery and logistics for raw material orders?

For industrial raw material shipments across many sites, JITSY oversees delivery through dependable
logistics partners, guaranteeing prompt dispatch, safe transit, and seamless order fulfillment.

What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) on JITSY?

The minimal order quantity one can place on JITSY depends on product category, packaging demands,
and supplier. Buyers can inspect the minimum order quantity directly through the product listing or
by calling to inquire.

Which brands and manufacturers does JITSY source products from?

JITSY sources industrial raw materials from renowned domestic and international brands, authorized
suppliers, and manufacturers. They source from suppliers who are popular for their quality,
consistency, reliability, and customer support.

Can I track my order status after placing it on JITSY?

JITSY enables buyers to measure order status through their mobile app. We offer updates through
order confirmation, shipment progress, and dispatch updates. We sent estimated delivery information
in real-time through mail.

## Frequently Asked **Questions**

What is JITSY, and how does it work for industrial buyers?
JITSY is the virtual B2B platform that supports industrial buyers to source raw materials smartly
and efficiently. Buyers can compare products, place their orders, compare prices, and manage
deliveries through the simple mobile app designed for industrial purchasing requirements.
How can I buy raw materials from the JITSY mobile app?

To buy raw materials from the JITSY app, download the app first, search for the raw materials,
choose products, add items to the cart, request quotation & proforma invoice, and place an order by
approving securely through the app in a few easy steps.

What types of industrial raw materials does JITSY supply?

JITSY supplies a wide array of industrial raw materials, including polymers, chemicals, additives,
packaging materials, and manufacturing essentials sourced from trusted brands and manufacturers
throughout various industrial categories.

Which industries does JITSY serve with its raw material portfolio?

JITSY serves the raw materials to industries like automotive, construction, plastic, packaging,
chemical, electrical, manufacturing, and consumer goods. We offer reliable accessibility to
high-quality industrial raw materials and supply solutions.

How does JITSY's pricing work? Are there any hidden charges?

JITSY promotes transparent pricing depending on market rates and supply quotations. Buyers will get
transparent details before confirming orders, with zero additional charges involved in the
purchasing process.

How does JITSY ensure the quality and authenticity of raw materials?

JITSY sources products from verified manufacturers and trusted suppliers while managing strict
quality inspections to verify that buyers obtain quality industrial raw materials for their
workflows.

How does JITSY handle delivery and logistics for raw material orders?

For industrial raw material shipments across many sites, JITSY oversees delivery through dependable
logistics partners, guaranteeing prompt dispatch, safe transit, and seamless order fulfillment.

What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) on JITSY?

The minimal order quantity one can place on JITSY depends on product category, packaging demands,
and supplier. Buyers can inspect the minimum order quantity directly through the product listing or
by calling to inquire.

Which brands and manufacturers does JITSY source products from?

JITSY sources industrial raw materials from renowned domestic and international brands, authorized
suppliers, and manufacturers. They source from suppliers who are popular for their quality,
consistency, reliability, and customer support.

Can I track my order status after placing it on JITSY?

JITSY enables buyers to measure order status through their mobile app. We offer updates through
order confirmation, shipment progress, and dispatch updates. We sent estimated delivery information
in real-time through mail.

Most standard reports are delivered **instantly via email** in PDF format. Specialized or newly
updated reports are typically delivered within 24-48 business hours after payment confirmation.
Can I request customization for a specific region?

on most reports to include specific countries, niche segments, or deep-dive competitor profiling as
per your needs.

# Stop losing the context behind every solution decision.

How it flows

## One record keeps the whole trail connected.

No new section has to restart the story. StackTrack follows the same object from first note to final
decision.

01

Capture

### Start with the messy inputs.

Save the product, vendor, event, contact, quote, pricing note, screenshot, or quick thought while it
is still fresh.

02

Connect

### Let the context gather around the record.

Each solution can carry notes, relationships, contacts, event conversations, ratings, integrations,
and project context.

03

Remember

### Come back to the reason, not just the outcome.

When a tool is chosen, rejected, replaced, or revisited, StackTrack keeps the trail that explains
why.

Why it exists

### Research usually fails after the meeting, not during the search.

Most software research does not fail because teams lack options. It fails because the reasoning
disappears.

Six months after rejecting a vendor, you should still be able to see who you spoke with, what they
quoted, what concerns came up, which project it was for, and why the team passed.

StackTrack gives that context a permanent home. It works as a private software evaluation tool,
vendor research log, service comparison workspace, and software stack management system for teams
that need more than a list of links.

Instead of spreading research across spreadsheets, browser tabs, meeting notes, Slack threads,
conference badges, pricing screenshots, and inbox follow-ups, StackTrack connects each tool or
vendor to the project, person, event, price, status, and decision that made it matter.

One record

Every evaluated product, service, vendor, or provider keeps its trail.

Read the full context->

StackTrack is built around solutions, not only software. A record can represent a product, service,
agency, platform, marketplace, hardware vendor, or any provider your team is evaluating.

When you add a solution from search or the catalog, it becomes part of your private workspace with
status, rating, strategic notes, research history, pricing, contacts, projects, and event or booth
context.

That means a pricing note from a vendor call, a product demo takeaway, a provider comparison, a
trade show conversation, or a replacement decision can all stay connected to the same record.

Instead of spreading solution research across spreadsheets, browser tabs, screenshots, emails,
conference notes, and contact lists, StackTrack keeps the operational context together.

Private by default

### Your internal context is not the public profile.

Your private notes, contacts, pricing, and internal decision history stay private. Public profiles
and community signals are separate from your private workspace.

Review sites help you compare what other people say. StackTrack helps you remember what happened in
your own evaluation.

That distinction matters for vendor management and software buying. Public research can help you
discover alternatives, but it cannot preserve your internal requirements, budget constraints,
renewal concerns, implementation risks, security questions, or the exact sales engineer who promised
a follow-up.

StackTrack keeps your team-owned decision memory separate from anonymized community insights, so you
can use public signals without turning private evaluation notes into public reviews.

# USPS.com Home Page

## Online Shipping Made Easy

Ship from home in 3 easy steps. Use our online Click-N-Ship^{®} service to pay for postage, print
your own shipping labels, and schedule a free package pickup.

[**Ship Now**][160][**Learn More**][161]

**Postmarks:** If you want to ensure that your mail receives a postmark on the day you mail it, ask
a retail associate at a Post Office retail counter to hand-cancel it for free. [Learn more][183]

## Featured USPS^{®} Products & Services

[Person looking at a clipboard with shelves of packages in the background]

### USPS Ground Advantage^{®}

USPS Ground Advantage is a great option for shippers of all sizes with delivery in 2-5* days and
USPS Tracking^{®} included in the price.

[Learn More about USPS Ground Advantage.][184]

*For mailable items up to 70 lbs. Expected delivery in 2-5 days. Packages going to certain places
(including Alaska, Hawaii, and offshore destinations) or containing hazardous materials or live
animals may receive slower service.

[Informed Delivery Daily Digest email on a smartphone.]

### Informed Delivery^{®} Emails

On the go? Stay on top of your mail and package deliveries with free Daily Digest emails that show
you what's coming to your mailbox soon.

[Sign Up for Free for Informed Delivery Emails.][185]

[Small Business owner preparing to ship Priority Mail packages.]

### Small Business Solutions

Get back to business with direct mail. Send announcements and promotions to your target customers
along selected postal routes.

[Learn More about Small Business Solutions][186]

[A PO Box with a key in the lock.]

### PO Box^{™} Online Services

Get a PO Box to keep all your mail secure at a Post Office^{™} facility. Reserve and then manage
your PO Box easily online with a free USPS.com account.

[Go Now for PO Box Online Services][187]

[Declaration of Independence Forever® Stamp]

### Declaration of Independence Forever^{®} Stamps

As the nation marks the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence, pay tribute to the
document that gave voice to America's founding ideals.

[Buy Declaration of Independence Forever® Stamps Now][188]

## North American Soccer

If you get a text or email claiming to be from USPS about a package awaiting action or a delivery

# USPS.com Home Page

## Online Shipping Made Easy

Ship from home in 3 easy steps. Use our online Click-N-Ship^{®} service to pay for postage, print
your own shipping labels, and schedule a free package pickup.

[**Ship Now**][160][**Learn More**][161]

**Postmarks:** If you want to ensure that your mail receives a postmark on the day you mail it, ask
a retail associate at a Post Office retail counter to hand-cancel it for free. [Learn more][183]

## Featured USPS^{®} Products & Services

[Person looking at a clipboard with shelves of packages in the background]

### USPS Ground Advantage^{®}

USPS Ground Advantage is a great option for shippers of all sizes with delivery in 2-5* days and
USPS Tracking^{®} included in the price.

[Learn More about USPS Ground Advantage.][184]

*For mailable items up to 70 lbs. Expected delivery in 2-5 days. Packages going to certain places
(including Alaska, Hawaii, and offshore destinations) or containing hazardous materials or live
animals may receive slower service.

[Informed Delivery Daily Digest email on a smartphone.]

### Informed Delivery^{®} Emails

On the go? Stay on top of your mail and package deliveries with free Daily Digest emails that show
you what's coming to your mailbox soon.

[Sign Up for Free for Informed Delivery Emails.][185]

[Small Business owner preparing to ship Priority Mail packages.]

### Small Business Solutions

Get back to business with direct mail. Send announcements and promotions to your target customers
along selected postal routes.

[Learn More about Small Business Solutions][186]

[A PO Box with a key in the lock.]

### PO Box^{™} Online Services

Get a PO Box to keep all your mail secure at a Post Office^{™} facility. Reserve and then manage
your PO Box easily online with a free USPS.com account.

[Go Now for PO Box Online Services][187]

[Declaration of Independence Forever® Stamp]

### Declaration of Independence Forever^{®} Stamps

As the nation marks the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence, pay tribute to the
document that gave voice to America's founding ideals.

[Buy Declaration of Independence Forever® Stamps Now][188]

### Alert: Text & Email Scams

If you get a text or email claiming to be from USPS about a package awaiting action or a delivery
failure, don't click it: Delete it immediately. This is an attempt to steal your personal
information. Find out how to protect yourself.
